svg.title: Importing a bank statement
svg.desc: 1. The user picks a target wallet and a statement file. 2. The file is read on the device: PDF with a self-hosted pdf.js worker, spreadsheets in the browser. 3. The format is detected, and columns can be mapped by hand when needed. 4. BYM returns a preview that flags duplicates by fingerprint and matches transfers between the user's own wallets. 5. On confirmation the rows are saved as one import batch, which can later be cancelled and undone.
svg.text: The user picks a target wallet
